rules.source: Organic Law on the Protection of Personal Data (LOPDP), enacted 26 May 2021, fully effective 26 May 2023 — Ecuador's first comprehensive data protection law, modeled on GDPR, establishing requirements for consent, security measures, and transparency, including for data processed by AI systems; creates the Superintendency of Personal Data Protection as the national regulator. https://www.clym.io/regulations/organic-law-on-the-protection-of-personal-data-lopdp-ecuador

LOPDP — compliance obligations vary by the type of data processed, explicitly including data of children or adolescents as a distinct sensitive category requiring particular attention alongside health and credit data. https://www.mondaq.com/data-protection/1325244/beginning-of-the-sanctioning-regime-of-the-organic-law-on-personal-data-protection
